claims.text: Artificial tears QID, or up to ten ×/day if preservative-free
claims.quote: Treatment includes using artificial tears for lubrication four times a day or up to ten times a day with preservative-free tears.
Cool compresses with a wet washcloth to the periocular area may provide symptomatic relief.
Symptom relief with artificial tears, cold-compresses, and antihistamines can be effective.
